name: Catchuparr
description: Local rolling catch-up archive and start-over for Dispatcharr
author: nilleiz

fields.label: Channel and source filter (YAML)
fields.help_text: Use version: 1, profile: all or a Dispatcharr channel profile, and rules with channels selected by numbers, names, groups, or profile. Include/exclude filters apply only to already assigned M3U sources. Validate before Apply; blank YAML selects no channels. Source filters may need another provider slot.

fields.label: Archive path
fields.help_text: A local filesystem shared by web and Celery workers.

fields.label: User ID for new M3U token
fields.help_text: Set the Dispatcharr user ID before creating an access token.
